[[Xamuel Lennox]] was part of a proud '''family'''<ref name="GalacticFiles">{{Topps|set=2013 Topps Star Wars Galactic Files Series 2|cardname=Captain Lennox (Imperial Officer)|link=https://i.ebayimg.com/images/g/HpcAAOSwprVjXGX~/s-l1200.jpg}}</ref> with a military tradition. As a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Captain/Legends|captain]] of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire's]] [[Imperial-class Star Destroyer/Legends|''Imperial''-class Star Destroyer]] [[Rebel Dream|''Tyrant'']], Xamuel Lennox was the scion of the noble line of [[Gender/Legends|men]]<ref name="Who">{{InsiderCite|96|The Empire's Finest: Who's Who in the Imperial Military}}</ref> who served as [[Officer/Legends|officers]] for several generations.<ref name="CSWE">{{CSWECite|II|250|Lennox, Captain Xamuel}}</ref>
